newsitem.title: USA: Christie's signs Rockefeller lease - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Christie's signs Rockefeller lease - NYT.

text.p: Auction house Christies International plc has signed a 30-year lease for space in the Rockefeller Center for an undisclosed sum, the New York Times said on Tuesday.
Christie's, which has been trying to find a larger space in Manhattan for two years, would move its New York headquarters to 20 Rockefeller Plaza from Park Avenue and 59th Street, the paper said.
The auction house would spend $40 million on renovations and hoped to move by the fall of 1998, the paper said.
The agreement was signed with RCPI Trust, owners of the Rockefeller Center, the paper said.
